successfulPreparationSteps: Build the pinned maintained HEIC runtime
workflow.activeStep: Serve the demo for a bounded five-hour review
workflow.scope: Readiness and bounded serving observed; the five-hour workflow is intentionally not terminal yet.

readyMarker.audience: LongBall demo review with simulated Roma U10 teams and matches

assetVerification: SHA256 and Git blob IDs were computed from the immutable local Git objects at the exact transport. These are packaged-file measurements, not a claim that this observer fetched live API bytes.

review.operatingMode: Bounded fictional review on an existing standard public GitHub runner; no paid service was provisioned.

limitations: The ready status was read through GitHub MCP and matched to the exact transport/run. Parent-owned public health, source-stamp, byte and account journeys are separate proof.
The service is temporary and expires at the recorded time; readiness is not a whole-job success or a durable production deployment.
No real-child operating-policy approval, paid provider setup, signed distribution, installation or physical-device acceptance is claimed.

provenance.method: Read-only GitHub workflow job metadata and ready-marker file, plus immutable local Git object hashing.
